This week's board
Try Chase · Try Tug
Solo. Chase puts a tank behind you. Tug pulls against a bot, or your ghost when you have one. One rower is enough.
Ghost
PB gap
Uses your best row of the same distance (and machine). No PB yet = no gap shown.
◌ Echo Rival
Uses your last 5 finished rows of the same workout on the same stage (and machine). Your PB ghost is separate.

for 2000 m
Race field
Stroke-rate zone
The track and the SPM screen turn green in the zone, amber below, red above.
Calm mode
Just you, the music and the stars. No race, no pressure – only time and metres on screen.
Your targets
Difficulty
Scaled rows show a coloured timeline (blue = slower than target, green = on target, red = faster), an "up next" box and a pulsing stroke-rhythm light.
Calibration Run
20-minute testRow 20:00 as hard as you can hold evenly. Your average split = your threshold.
Ramp testStarts at 2:30 /500m and gets 3 s faster every minute. Hold each step as long as you can (about 8-15 min).
Logbook

Sign-in and “Save this piece?” stay in Settings. Custom is the first tab.
Custom

Each row is its own work and rest. Rest on the last row is not used — the piece ends there.

Arcade
Rowing games
Laser Run
Row harder to climb, ease off to sink. Every stroke fires a twin laser that locks onto targets near your height.
◆ Asteroid 10◆ Drone 25◆ Crystal 50 (high)× Mines & void rays: −1 shieldHit streaks build a ×5 combo
Round
Level
High scores
Comet Tail
Hold your target split and your ship grows a glowing tail. Drift off pace and it slowly shrinks. Judged on the average of your last 4 strokes, band ±1 s. Longest tail wins. Rounds are 5 minutes.

Public races
Join, then wait: the 10-second countdown starts by itself before the start time.
Server
Race server = real people (CosmicRow's free server - it may need up to a minute to wake up). Practice = everything on this device with simulated online rowers (5 updates a second, with network delay), no internet needed. You can also enter another server address.

Weekly club challenge
Team races
Your clubs
Profile
Used for age groups, weight classes and heart-rate zones. Stays on this device unless you join a server league.
Heart-rate strap
Rowing HR bands
Lower bound of each band in bpm. HR comes from the PM5 (paired strap / ANT+ belt on the monitor) or a Bluetooth strap. Drives the afterburner colour and the HR chip.
Settings
Saved automatically
Music
Sound
Colour theme
Saved with your profile. Classic Cyan is the original look.
Power 10
A 10-stroke burst: press P or P10 in a race. The HUD counts the strokes down, then shows your average watts. Your speed still comes only from your rowing.
Big numbers
Tablet / erg layout: split, stroke rate, watts, distance and time much larger, readable from about 1 m, with bigger buttons. Auto turns it on for tablets.
Pilots online
Your name, flag, ship and what you're rowing are shown to other pilots while the game is open. Nothing is stored.
Rear-view mirror
A small strip at the top showing what's behind you (rivals, ghosts, guides, the tank). Never covers your numbers.
Camera
Bridge: a wide ship-bridge window with your stats on the neon screens of the desk. Also C or the ◉ button during a race (Chase → Cockpit → Bridge).
HUD screens
Colours
Colour-blind safe swaps green / amber / red for yellow / blue / vermilion in zones, gaps and the target timeline (text labels stay).
Chase-view HUD
Cockpit view always keeps the detailed dashboard.
Afterburner
With a heart-rate strap connected, your engine flame, glow and trail take the colour of your HR zone (same colours as the HR chip), blending smoothly between zones. Without a strap the flame keeps your Garage colour (unless the estimate is on). Rivals keep their own colours.
Story screens before a race
Machine
Rowing input
PM5 uses Web Bluetooth (Chrome / Edge / Android). Without it, SPACE or a tap is one stroke.
Heart-rate strap
Any Bluetooth heart-rate strap or watch that broadcasts heart rate (Polar, Garmin, Wahoo, Coospo…). Shown on the HUD with your zone and saved with every row.
Keys
SPACE / tap = stroke · C = camera · M = mute · ESC = back / end · ENTER = race
Laser Run: ← → (or A / D) slide sideways
Quality
Concept2 Logbook
Off by default. Your PM5 already records the piece and can upload it. A second save creates a duplicate Logbook entry (409). When this is on, one question after the row shows the PM5 distance, time and pace.
Dev server saves test pieces. Live sign-in reads log.concept2.com. Save stays greyed out until Concept2 approves writes. A piece is saved only after Concept2 accepts it. Strava and Garmin sync from Logbook Applications once live write is approved.
Where results go
Results can save to the Concept2 Logbook. Strava and Garmin sync from Logbook Applications once live write is approved.
Progress
Ships unlock with pilot XP (Profile › Stats): Raven 100 · Valkyrie 300 · Nebula 600 · Titan 1,000 · Phoenix 1,500 · Star Rider 2,500 + a secret challenge. Colours unlock by metres and streaks.
Test pilot
TEST has its own XP, ships, PBs, history and ghosts, which never mix with your real pilot. It is never ranked (no leagues, weekly boards, clubs or Pilots online) and never saves to the Concept2 Logbook or Strava. Switching reloads the game.
Concept2 connect
Public Client ID and Worker URL. The client secret stays on the Worker. Players sign in from Logbook — these fields are for setup.
Ships
For trying every ship. Your XP and real progress are kept: turn it off and ships go back to what your XP has unlocked.
